import tensorflow as tf from tensorflow.keras.applications import ResNet50 from tensorflow.keras.layers import Dense, GlobalAveragePooling2D, Dropout from tensorflow.keras.models import Model
def build_model(input_shape=(224, 224, 3)): """ Build a deepfake detection model using ResNet50 as base. """ base_model = ResNet50(weights='imagenet', include_top=False, input_shape=input_shape)
x = base_model.output x = GlobalAveragePooling2D()(x) x = Dense(1024, activation='relu')(x) x = Dropout(0.5)(x) predictions = Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')(x) # Binary classification
model = Model(inputs=base_model.input, outputs=predictions)
# Freeze base layers for transfer learning for layer in base_model.layers: layer.trainable = False
return model
